scope: Read-only SHA/JSON/NPY/static source audit. No shadow/voxelizer/mesh/simulation call; no installation. New files only this evidence and design documents.

grid.boundary_rule: positive-area presence/support; closed-set centre; affine maximum on polygon closure
grid.sampling_location: cell centres locate cells; roof evaluation is method-specific

orientation.approximation: one local grid bearing per small scene; no per-cell correction
orientation.conversion: axis-0 reflection on inputs and outputs; true azimuth unchanged; subtract recorded grid bearing

P1_1c_existing_grid_probe.limitation: read-only old-grid point lookup, not shadow or future D0-grid mask; outside old domain is not classified
